Default.inAMomentTell: ($1) - in a moment, tell me whether you want Ludio to teach your group how to play this game!
captionSourceTargets: Teams can write their own captions
Default.doYouWantTo: ($1), do you want to use the standard caption list?
Default.eachTeamIsGiven: Each team is given their own caption
Default.asATeamYou:
As a team, you must draw that caption on a shared whiteboard before your timer runs out.

The captions tend to be on the wacky side! For example, the caption for this drawing was every action movie.
Default.oneDrawingIsRevealed: One drawing is revealed at a time
Default.everyTeamBesidesThe: Every team (besides the team whose drawing is being shown) submits their own caption for the drawing.
Default.allTheFakeCaptions: All the fake captions are revealed anonymously
Default.amongTheseCaptionsIs: Among these captions is also the original real caption for the drawing. After seeing all the captions, each player must individually click on the caption that THEY think is the real one.
Default.youGet20Points:
You get 20 points if you correctly click on the real caption for the drawing.
You get 10 points per player for each player who voted for your team's fake caption!

You can see your score in the bottom-right of your video box.
Default.whenYourTeamS: When your team's drawing is being shown...
Default.thenDuringTheVoting: ... then during the voting phase, vote for your favorite incorrect caption. The team that submitted this caption will get a "like" (❤️) from you.
Default.weGotYourPicture: We got your picture for "($1)". Please wait while the other teams finish up!
Default.isFromTeamGet: ... is from Team ($1)! Get ready to come up with your fake caption as a team.
Default.whatIsYourTeam: What is your team's caption for this picture?
Default.whatDoYouThink: What do you think is the real caption for this picture?
Default.whatDoYouThink2: What do you think is the real caption for this picture? If you're on Team ($1), vote for your favorite fake caption!
Default.letSSeeHow: Let's see how you all voted!
Default.theRealCaptionWas: The real caption was: "($1)". The host can click on it to continue!
Default.wouldYouLikeTo: Would you like to play again?
